live: {channel} is live now — come say hi!
needCredentials: Connect your site to Twitch in the Twitch connector to show the player only when you are live. Without it, the player is not shown.
needChannel: Enter your channel in My Twitch channel to show the player only when you are live. Without it, the player is not shown.
liveYoutube: Live on YouTube — come say hi!
ytNote: Nothing is loaded from YouTube before you click. Once started, the player connects to YouTube (Google).
needSource: No live source is installed: without one there is no banner and no player. Install My Twitch channel or YouTube channel.
suggestTwitch: knows when you are live on Twitch (My Twitch channel)
suggestYoutube: knows when you are live on YouTube (YouTube channel)
ytNeedChannel: Enter your channel in YouTube channel to announce your YouTube lives.
ytNeedKey: Connect your site to YouTube (key in the YouTube connector) to announce your YouTube lives.
ytQuota: YouTube limits the number of checks per day and the limit is reached: your YouTube lives will not be announced until tomorrow.
ytDown: YouTube is not answering right now: your YouTube lives are not announced. It recovers by itself.
